name: Sir Isaac Newton
subject_label: SUBJECT — what is on this page:
summary: Engraved figures from Opticks and the Principia (rays, lenses, orbits, lettered points) and his own manuscript notebook pages. Never flip: the letters reverse.

plate.about: an engraved Opticks-style plate: several numbered geometrical figures (rays, lenses, prisms) scattered on one sheet

figure.about: one engraved Principia-style figure on a mostly empty page: compass circles, orbits, trajectories, lettered points

notebook.about: a manuscript notebook page: brown ink, dense slanting hand, one small working sketch set into the text

public_summary: Pages and figures from his own books and manuscripts: the Principia (1687 and the editions he oversaw), the Opticks, his notebooks and papers. Engraved geometric figures with lettered points, orbits, prisms and lenses, title pages, handwritten pages.
